Can you explain the main options in simple terms?

Sent · Just now

ByRo Bot · AI says:

Here’s a quick, simple breakdown of the main options you’ll see on By Rotation:

Paying for rentals

Use lending earnings (Wallet balance) directly at checkout.
Or withdraw to your bank, then pay with a regular card.

Lender levels (tiers)

Active → Muse → Pro. As you lend more reliably, you unlock:
Special badges on your profile
Better search visibility
Extra perks and, at Pro level, dedicated support

Sending or receiving items

Delivery: Post with tracked, insured shipping that arrives by the first rental day.
In‑person collection: Meet in a public place and hand the item over directly.
You can switch between delivery and collection in the app after booking (with either a postage refund or an added shipping invoice).

Using credit vs Wallet balance

Credit: Shows on your profile, is automatically applied at checkout, and returns to your balance if a rental is rejected, expires, or is cancelled.
Wallet balance (earnings): Money you’ve earned from lending; you can spend it on rentals or withdraw to your bank.

Buying and selling instead of renting

Only Verified Lenders can sell.
Buyer sends a purchase request via the Buy button.
Once accepted, the sale is final: no refunds.
Seller fee: 12%; Buyer fee: 10%.

Pricing your rentals (for lenders)

Set daily, weekly, and monthly prices (longer rentals usually slightly cheaper per day).
Optionally add a cleaning fee (for genuine dry‑clean costs) and a postage fee.
All prices are fixed – no haggling in messages.

In short, you can: earn and spend via Wallet, climb from Active to Pro with good lending, choose delivery or collection for items, use credits automatically, buy/sell via Verified Lenders, and control clear, upfront pricing on your listings.

To use By Rotation properly on your very first go:

Sign up on the app: Download the app, tap the profile icon, hit Get Started, and create an account with email, Apple ID, or Facebook, then complete your profile.

What's the return policy if it turns out not to be right for me?

ByRo Bot · AI says:

If a rental isn’t right for you, refunds mainly depend on why and on the lender’s policy:

Doesn’t fit / not right for you: Refunds are only given if the lender chooses to allow them; many state this in their bio. Any fit refund is app credit only, no cash, and delivery/cleaning fees are non‑refundable.
To request a refund, you must return the item within 24 hours of receiving it, then:
Open the rental in the app → Request Refund → enter the amount.
The lender must approve; once approved it’s processed in about 8 working days, rental cost only (platform fees are non‑refundable).
If the item arrives late (after the first rental day) and you don’t use it, you may be eligible for a full refund if you notify us immediately and return it within 24 hours.
If it arrives in poor condition or misrepresented, take photos the day it arrives, message the lender right away, return within 24 hours, and submit a refund request.
If a lender doesn’t respond to a refund request within 72 hours, or there’s an issue with a poor‑condition item, you can email help@byrotation.com for help.

If you keep and use the item for the full rental period, you generally won’t be eligible for a refund.
